description: Build the egui-free, unit-testable building blocks for the three-flavor SNAPSHOT: (B) Unicode box-drawing in the Markdown fenced block; a window-capture payload constructor; the CF_HTML composite builder; and the egui ColorImage->RasterImage adapter. These are independent of the shell frame-loop wiring (FEAT-002) except that FEAT-002 consumes them, so FEAT-001 lands first. No behaviour change to the live SNAPSHOT path yet -- that flip happens in FEAT-002.
steps: Part B: in crates/ff-screen-model/src/render/markdown.rs::render_markdown, change the fenced code block render from RenderOptions{ unicode_box: false } to { unicode_box: true } (line ~19). Keep the triple-backtick fence, property table, and table sections unchanged. Update the existing markdown_has_heading_code_block_and_table test; ADD a test asserting the fenced body contains a U+2500-family glyph (build expected chars from '\u{2500}'/'\u{250C}' CONSTANTS in the test -- never a raw box glyph in source) and contains no ASCII '+'/'|' frame glyph. // Validates: screen-snapshot-scrm Req 4.4, 5.1.

In crates/ff-desktop/src/clipboard_backend.rs: add pub html: Option<String> to SnapshotPayload; set html:None in from_model. Add pub fn from_window_capture(image: RasterImage, text: String) -> Self that sets png = ff_screen_model::encode_png(&image), stores the given image+text, html:None (NO model rasterisation). Add an html:bool field to OfferedFlavors (keep both() meaning image&&text). Add a unit test building a 2x1 stub RasterImage asserting png has the 8-byte PNG signature and text round-trips. // Validates: Req 23.4, 23.5d.

Create crates/ff-desktop/src/clipboard_html.rs: pub fn build_cf_html(png: &[u8], pre_text: &str) -> String producing the HTML fragment ( + 
{html-escaped pre_text}
) wrapped in the CF_HTML header (Version:0.9, StartHTML/EndHTML/StartFragment/EndFragment with correct UTF-8 BYTE offsets) and / markers. Implement base64 and HTML-escape in-module (no new dep). Keep <400 lines, functions <40 lines. Add mod clipboard_html; to crates/ff-desktop/src/main.rs (alphabetical near clipboard_backend). Unit tests: parse the four header integers back and assert each indexes the expected byte (fragment markers/document bounds); assert the data:image/png;base64, prefix is present; assert the box-drawn text is inside 
. // Validates: Req 23.5c, 23.5d.

Create crates/ff-desktop/src/screenshot.rs: pub fn color_image_to_raster(image: &egui::ColorImage) -> ff_screen_model::RasterImage copying image.as_raw() RGBA bytes and width/height. <40 lines; the ONLY new egui-touching code (stays in ff-desktop, keeping ff-screen-model egui-free). Add mod screenshot; to crates/ff-desktop/src/main.rs. Unit test: build a small egui::ColorImage from known RGBA and assert the RasterImage width/height/rgba match. // Validates: Req 23.4, 2.4.

Extend crates/ff-desktop/src/clipboard_backend.rs OsClipboard::place (#[cfg(windows)]): after the CF_UNICODETEXT + CF_DIB + CF_DIBV5 writes, when payload.html is Some, raw::register_format("HTML Format") then raw::set_without_clear(fmt, html.as_bytes()); set flavors.html=true on success. Update the FakeClipboard test fake + assertions to report/verify all three flavors when present (image, text, html). Leave the #[cfg(not(windows))] arboard fallback unchanged (no CF_HTML off-Windows). // Validates: Req 23.4, 23.5d, 23.5e.

findings:
FEAT-001 complete and compile-verified in the worktree (branch scrm-2b). All FEAT-002 consumption points: == Part B (ff-screen-model) == - crates/ff-screen-model/src/render/markdown.rs::render_markdown now renders the fenced code block with RenderOptions{ unicode_box: true } (U+2500-family box glyphs inside the ``` fence). No signature change; SnapshotFormat::Markdown -> ff_screen_model::render(..) already picks this up. Raster path (rasterise_screen) still uses unicode_box:false (ASCII) by design -- unchanged. == Module paths (declared in crates/ff-desktop/src/main.rs) == - mod clipboard_html; (near clipboard_backend, alphabetical) - mod screenshot; (after screen_snapshot) Both new modules carry #[allow(dead_code)] on their public fn until FEAT-002 wires them; REMOVE those allows (or let them go live) once called, else they stay harmless. == New / changed public API == 1. crate::screenshot::color_image_to_raster(image: &egui::ColorImage) -> ff_screen_model::RasterImage Copies image.as_raw() RGBA + image.size [usize;2] into RasterImage{width:u32,height:u32,rgba:Vec}. This is the ONLY egui-touching adapter; call it on the egui::Event::Screenshot { image: Arc, .. } payload (deref the Arc). 2. crate::clipboard_html::build_cf_html(png: &[u8], pre_text: &str) -> String Returns the full CF_HTML payload (Version:0.9 header + StartHTML/EndHTML/StartFragment/EndFragment byte offsets + / markers, over 
{escaped pre_text}
). base64 + HTML-escape are in-module (no dep). Pass the PNG bytes (payload.png) and the box-drawn pre text (the Markdown-fenced body WITHOUT the ``` fence, OR the plain Unicode-box text -- owner wants the box-drawn screen text inside 
). Store the result into payload.html before placing.

3. crate::clipboard_backend::SnapshotPayload now has field: pub html: Option (set to None by both constructors). Set payload.html = Some(build_cf_html(&payload.png, pre_text)) after building the payload.

4. crate::clipboard_backend::SnapshotPayload::from_window_capture(image: RasterImage, text: String) -> Self
   PNG-encodes the GIVEN captured window raster (ff_screen_model::encode_png) and stores image+text, html:None. Does NOT rasterise a model -- use this for the live egui window grab (image = color_image_to_raster(screenshot)). text = the box-drawn text flavor (SnapshotFormat::Markdown render for the bare SNAPSHOT path). from_model(model, text) is unchanged and still rasterises the model (use only where no live grab).

5. crate::clipboard_backend::OfferedFlavors now has field: pub html: bool. both() still means image && text (html is reported separately). OsClipboard::place (#[cfg(windows)]) already publishes CF_HTML via raw::register_format(\"HTML Format\") + raw::set_without_clear when payload.html.is_some(), setting flavors.html=true; the non-Windows arboard fallback is unchanged (no CF_HTML). FakeClipboard test fake reports html when payload.html is non-empty.

== FEAT-002 wiring plan (for reference) ==
- egui 0.33 screenshot is ASYNC: request with ctx.send_viewport_cmd(egui::ViewportCommand::Screenshot(egui::UserData::default())); the image arrives a LATER frame as egui::Event::Screenshot read via ctx.input(|i| i.raw.events...). Needs a pending-request flag on shell state (shell/state.rs) drained in shell/update.rs (the deferred-action frame-loop pattern, like pending_menu_option).
- Bare SNAPSHOT (no arg): drop the old format picker; request a window screenshot, then on the Screenshot event build SnapshotPayload::from_window_capture(color_image_to_raster(&img), markdown_text), set payload.html = Some(build_cf_html(&payload.png, pre_text)), and OsClipboard.place(&payload).
